description: Zone réglementée du PPRT "SOCIETE DEULEP" sur la commune de Port-Saint-Louis-du-Rhône - Bouches-du-Rhône is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by bouches-du-rhone.gouv.fr. For PPRTs, the environmental code defines a single category of zones for zones (L515-15 et seq.): areas at risk. Unlike natural RPPs, PPRTs never have restricted areas that are not directly exposed to risk.Depending on the hazard level, each TPP area is subject to enforceable regulation. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Restricted zone of the PPRT “SOCIETE DEULEP” in the commune of Port-Saint-Louis-du-Rhône — Bouches-du-Rhône" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include bouches-du-rhône, pprt deulep, données ouvertes, port-saint-louis-du-rhône. The listing shows 2021-03-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
